outcome: Low Apgar scores (<7) at 1 and 5 minutes
finding: Velamentous cord insertion (VCI) was associated with increased risks of preterm delivery, low birth weight, small for gestational age, and admission to the neonatal unit.
mod_finding: Women with VCI had a higher rate of emergency cesarean section compared to women without VCI (16.1% vs 8.9%, P < .001).
birth_weight: Low birth weight defined as <2500 g
